name: Stormwind Ho!
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
My former mentor in the Stormwind city guard sent a message to me that Alliance High Command is becoming concerned with the threat posed by the naga. From what he's heard, there's good chances for promotion--or at least reassignment--for anyone who proves valuable in this regard.

There's just one small problem... I can't handle the naga, adventurer. Oh sure, I could break up a drunken barroom brawl, or haul off a belligerent beggar, but the naga are too much for me. You've got to help me, adventurer!
narrative.objectives: Kill 10 Daggerspine Shorehunters and 10 Daggerspine Sirens for Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in Southshore.
narrative.offerRewardText: With the naga put down in Southshore, I'll be a shoe-in to be reassigned. I'll get to see Stormwind again... get away from this Light-forsaken port.
narrative.requestItemsText: I've a letter ready to go to Major Samuelson in Stormwind. All I need are the results.
